verdict.rationale: React's own docs show that components manage their own state and that React updates the screen when data changes (react-gh-1, react-docs-3, react-docs-24). React Compiler's automatic memoization, which removes the need for manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo, reduces unnecessary re-execution, but it is an opt-in build step that safely skips optimization on rule-breaking code (react-docs-15, react-docs-36, react-docs-43). The evidence does not show that only the dependent UI code re-runs; updates happen at component level. Missing for 10: fine-grained dependency tracking so only dependent code re-runs, explicit docs on the state declaration API (e.g., useState), independent corroboration of re-render scope.
